answer: Reputation crystal escrow: each identity must grow a public score through paid work, and transfers only release it in fragments, so a clone starts at zero. A gale of cheap registrations fails because the first payout is withheld until the identity completes costly verified tasks whose records a mirror audit cross-checks against prior submissions. Cloning therefore costs full task labor per identity with no recoverable balance, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
